rationale: Stations barred from live trading. The bar is temporary by intent and revisable as data accumulates, but it is revised by a person, because the alternative was measured and does not work. Candidates for adding and releasing are recomputed every render and shown on the board; promoting a candidate is an edit to this file.
why_not_automatic: Walk-forward over the 332 settlements of 2026-08-15..29, warming up on six days and testing on the remaining nine: fourteen automatic rules were swept (ROI thresholds -8%/-25%/-50% crossed with minimum samples 3/5/8, plus both-halves-negative persistence at 4/6/8, plus their intersections). Every one landed between -6.8 and +1.8 points against a +5.6% baseline, and the best of the fourteen (ROI<=-25%, n>=5) is p=0.346 against randomly excluding the same number of stations -- so even that is a multiple-comparison artifact. The persistence rules were the worst of all: the stations they barred went on to return +26% to +44%, because a station that just lost is disproportionately about to mean-revert. The same nine-station hand list held fixed across the whole test returned +15.3 points at p=0.001, and with RKSI/KAUS/FACT added, +17.0 points at p=0.002. Judgement about the stations beats any statistic about their recent returns, so this file does not compute itself.

excluded_stations.note: Released and re-barred the same day (2026-08-30). The release was made over a contrary reading and the re-bar restores it: EPWA's six forward seats all lost 100% and its three wins were P1 near-certainties at claims 0.93-0.99 with the model running 1.62C cold and delivering 0.46 of what it claims; LTAC is the same shape at bias -0.83 and ratio 0.35. Recorded as a round trip rather than smoothed away, because a list that hides its own reversals cannot be scored later.

review_policy.cadence: every board render recomputes candidates; a person promotes them
review_policy.add_candidate_when: full-sample ROI <= -25% and at least 5 settlements
review_policy.release_candidate_when: barred, last 5 settled days ROI > 0 over at least 3 settlements, full-sample ROI > -25%, AND both structural gates pass (|centre bias| <= 0.8C, realized/claimed in [0.88,1.18])
review_policy.candidates_are_not_decisions: These two criteria are the least-bad of the fourteen swept and are still indistinguishable from random (p=0.346). They exist to put a station in front of a human with its numbers attached, not to move it. Do not wire them to an automatic edit of excluded_stations.

standing_candidates_2026_08_30.note: All candidates acted on by the operator on 2026-08-30; recomputed each render.

review_policy.why_release_is_stricter: Barring costs a skipped market; releasing puts money back, so the two directions are deliberately asymmetric. EPWA forced this on 2026-08-30: under an ROI-only rule it cleared on a 2.2-point technicality (-22.8% against the -25% line) with a five-day window reading +60.1%. Underneath, all six of its forward seats lost 100% (P0 5/5, P0-M 1/1), its only three wins were P1 near-certainties bought after the day was observed at claims of 0.93-0.99, and it runs 1.62C cold with a claim ratio of 0.46. The +60.1% was one P1 chain on 08-29 (+12.02 on 17.62), not a recovery. LTAC fails the same way at bias -0.83 and ratio 0.35.

watchlist_not_excluded.rationale: Persistently negative in both halves and not barred. Kept so a review starts from evidence rather than memory.

auto_policy.measured: Walk-forward on 332 settlements over 2026-08-15..29, warming on six days and scoring on nine: the best of sixteen automatic rules returned +2.4 points at p=0.356 against excluding the same number of stations at random. The operator's own ten-station list held fixed returned +15.6 points at p=0.001. This layer runs because it was asked for and because barring a station only costs a skipped market -- not because it was shown to pay.
